app.title: Half Dome
app.description:
A 3D scene of Half Dome in Yosemite Valley, on Esri's world terrain. Open Measure (the button under the compass and navigation buttons), start a distance and click the valley floor, then the summit: it shows the straight-line, horizontal and vertical distances between them. Switch to Area to measure a meadow on the terrain. Bookmarks, in the sidebar, fly to El Capitan, Yosemite Falls, Glacier Point and Clouds Rest, each from its own angle; views you add as bookmarks are kept in this browser.

Coordinates, below Measure, shows where the pointer is in decimal degrees and UTM. The two share a corner, so opening one closes the other. The button at the top right shows the whole app fullscreen.

This is a sample app. Replace it, or remove it from apps/index.json.
